mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.nickname as author_name, u.avatar as author_avatar, c.name as channel_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN channel c ON a.channel_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, content, cover_image, user_id, channel_id, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{userId}, #{channelId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
